name: sakana-discord-bot
description: A simple Discord bot built with discord.js.

scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && tsx --no-cache -e "Promise.all([import('./src/emotion.js'), import('./src/emotion-image.jsx')])" && node -e "import('./src/archive/query.js').then(({ parseQuery }) => { const a = parseQuery('regex:/(a|b)/').ast; if (a.type !== 'filter' || a.value !== '/(a|b)/') throw new Error('regex paren parse broken: ' + JSON.stringify(a)); const b = parseQuery('regex:/^(?!.*http).{200,}/').ast; if (b.type !== 'filter') throw new Error('regex lookahead parse broken'); const c = parseQuery('http://x.com').ast; if (c.type !== 'term' || c.value !== 'http://x.com') throw new Error('url must stay a plain term'); const d = parseQuery('sort:new'); if (d.ast !== null || d.directives.sort !== 'new') throw new Error('sort directive broken'); console.log('query parser ok'); })" && ARCHIVE_DB_PATH=/tmp/sakana-check.sqlite node -e "import('./src/commands.js').then(({ commandData }) => console.log(commandData.length + ' commands built'))" && ARCHIVE_DB_PATH=/tmp/sakana-check.sqlite DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=check node -e "import('./src/agent/index.js').then(({ isAgentRequest }) => console.log('agent module ok: ' + typeof isAgentRequest))" && node --check scripts/deploy-commands.js && python3 -m py_compile scripts/analyze-emotions.py scripts/embed-texts.py
